description: This Java class, HealthService, provides health check functionalities for an application and its database. It includes methods to determine overall service health and database-specific health status, utilizing a DataSource for database connectivity.

classes.name: HealthService
classes.description: Service class that performs health checks for the application and database.

methods.name: checkServiceHealth
methods.description: Performs a basic health check, returning UP if the service code executes.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth
methods.description: Checks database connectivity and validity of connection, reporting health status accordingly.
